photos.llama_desc: A man in a white t-shirt and blue jeans is sitting on a chair in front of a Christmas tree, surrounded by three children. The man is wearing a Santa hat and has his back to the camera, while the children are standing around him, one of them holding a Christmas ornament. The Christmas tree is decorated with lights and ornaments, and there is a red chair in the background.
A woman in a black cardigan, white t-shirt, light blue jeans, and black and white sneakers, with long brown hair, posing in front of a tree with green leaves and a blue sky.

A boy in a black suit, green shirt, and blue tie sits on a staircase with two girls in yellow and pink gingham dresses, one holding a stuffed rabbit. The boy has spiky brown hair and is smiling at the camera. The girls have long blonde hair and are also smiling.

A chocolate cake with a brown frosting and blue writing on top, held by someone's hand. The cake is rectangular in shape and has a gold border around it. The blue writing on top of the cake reads "Happy 19th Birthday Jacob!" in a cursive font.
A man in a white polo shirt and a woman in a black t-shirt stand together in front of a green hedge. The man has short, dark hair and is wearing glasses. The woman has long, light-brown hair.

A parade float with a large, animatronic, anthropomorphic lion's head, wearing a gold and blue costume, is being driven through a dark, night-time, urban or city environment. The lion's head is wearing a gold and blue costume, with a gold and blue cape, and a gold and blue crown.

A paper cup with a coffee or tea drink inside, viewed from above, with a red box of chocolate pieces and a white paper cup with a brown paper sleeve on a white surface. The paper cup has a green logo on its side and a brown paper sleeve with a green logo on its side. The red box of chocolate pieces has white text on its front.

A woman with long blonde hair, wearing a black and white striped top, a black jacket, and a gold sash with black text, is standing in front of a woman with short blonde hair, wearing a black and white striped top, a black jacket, and a gold sash with black text. The woman with long blonde hair is holding a phone in her right hand and has her left hand on her hip. The woman with short blonde hair is holding a gold sash with black text in her right hand and has her left hand on her hip.

A collection of postcards from the Swiss Alps. The postcards are arranged on a white surface, with some of them facing upwards and others lying flat. They feature various images of the Swiss Alps, including mountains, mountainside villages, and trains.

A child's art project featuring a white egg-shaped paper cutout with variously colored tissue paper and foil strips attached to it, on a purple background. The egg is surrounded by a few pink and green tissue paper pieces and a silver foil strip. The paper is signed with the name "JUIQ" in black marker at the top left corner.
